description: Microsoft .NET Framework 4.x runtime at its newest version (4.8.1): an in-place update of every 4.x, for apps built for it (such as CKAN-NetFx). Installs only if Windows does not have it yet.
notes: The newest .NET Framework 4.x (now 4.8.1) is part of Windows: Windows 11 22H2 and later include 4.8.1, and
Windows Update brings it to Windows 10 21H2 and 22H2. If it is already there, Scoop installs nothing and only
records the package. Otherwise it runs Microsoft's offline installer silently. 4.8.1 needs Windows 10 20H2 or later,
or Windows Server 2022 or later; restart Windows if Scoop asks you to.
Global install only, from an elevated shell: scoop install -g gesu/NetFx-4
'scoop uninstall' leaves .NET Framework in place: Windows and other programs use it. On Windows 10 it can be
removed in Control Panel > Programs > View installed updates (KB5011048 or the cumulative update for .NET Framework).
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app installs a Windows component: run this from an elevated shell."; break }
if (!$global) { error ".NET Framework is installed for the whole machine; install it globally: scoop install -g $app"; break }

script: # Release of the version this manifest installs: 533320 or higher means 4.8.1 or later (533325 on most systems,
# 533320 or 533509 on Windows 11). Update it together with 'version', 'url' and 'hash' (see the package page).
info ".NET Framework $((Get-ItemProperty $ndp).Version) is already installed (Release $release): nothing to do."
info "Installing .NET Framework $version silently; this takes a few minutes."
# 0: done; 3010 and 1641: done, a restart is needed; 5100: this Windows is not supported; 1602: cancelled.
if ($rc -eq 5100) { error ".NET Framework $version does not support this Windows; see the package page for the Windows versions it needs."; break }
if ($rc -notin 0, 1641, 3010) { error ".NET Framework setup failed with exit code $rc. Its logs are in %TEMP% (files named 'Microsoft .NET Framework*' and 'dd_*')."; break }
if ($rc -ne 0) { warn "Restart Windows to finish installing .NET Framework $version." }
# The installer is not needed any more; Scoop's cache keeps a copy.
# The 'NetFx 4' shortcut opens this micro-launcher, which shows the installed version.
':: .NET Framework 4: shows which .NET Framework 4.x is installed, then waits for a key.',
':: Written by the gesu Scoop bucket at install time.',
'ECHO .NET Framework 4 (gesu/NetFx-4) is part of Windows: programs built for it use it,',
'ECHO there is nothing to start. Installed .NET Framework 4.x:',
('ECHO Release 0x{0:x} ({0}) or higher is {1} or later.' -f $minRelease, $version),
info '.NET Framework stays installed: it is part of Windows, and other programs use it.'
